question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A royal ceremony in which a crown is placed on the head of a new King or a Queen.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Coronation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Coronation **is a noun that means a royal ceremony of crowning a new monarch. (एक नए राजा की ताजपोशी का शाही समारोह)
 
• It is derived from the Latin word "coronare" which means "to crown."
 
 
• **Example**: The coronation of Queen Elizabeth II was
